items.title: File Widerspruch against rehab rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.
items.computation: The letter itself fixes the fictional notification (Bekanntgabe) rule: 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.' Versandtag = Samstag, 21.11.2026. Counting 4 days after that day: 22.11 (Sun), 23.11 (Mon), 24.11 (Tue), 25.11 (Wed) -> Bekanntgabe = Mittwoch, 25.11.2026 (this fictional-notice date is not itself shifted for weekends/holidays). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §26 SGB X / §187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of the event (25.11.2026) is not counted, the period starts 26.11.2026 and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the event day, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 is a Friday and is 1. Weihnachtstag, a statutory holiday in NW; the following day 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag) is also a holiday; 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. Under §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next working day, Montag 28.12.2026.

warnings: All place names in this letter (Musterhessen-Lahn, Mustergießen, Mustermünster) and the agency name appear to be fictional/template placeholders, so this may be a sample or test document rather than a genuine Rentenversicherung notice — verify the sender and address independently before acting on the deadline.

The letter prints an IBAN in the footer even though no payment is requested or owed in this decision; treat any unexpected request to use this IBAN with suspicion and verify it through an official channel if one later appears.
